Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class ReportExporter

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.ReportExporter
public class ReportExporter extends Object
Runs every report generator and decides where the files go and what they are called. Files are saved in the BlueJ project folder and named after the project and the time the session ended.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh
